[[Jade Gate Statuette]] is a [[trophy]] awarded for completing the [[Kaineng Blackout]] [[meta event]] in [[New Kaineng City]] for the week. It is one of four statuettes in [[The Jade Vault]] [[collection]], and can be traded with [[Myung-Hee]] in [[Shing Jea Monastery]] once a week for a [[Bounty of New Kaineng City]].
